method: Tesseract vs Minimax VLM, LaTeX-aware scoring, threshold=0.35
methodology_note: Tesseract is fundamentally unsuited for Chinese math content; produces garbled output. Low scores reflect VLM-vs-Tesseract modality mismatch, not VLM quality. VLM output is structured LaTeX; Tesseract output is noise.
key_finding: Minimax VLM produces clean structured text (LaTeX+Chinese). Tesseract 5.5 fails completely on Chinese/math images. Comparison methodology is unreliable for this content type.
recommendation: Use human review or ground-truth comparison for math-heavy Chinese content. VLM appears to outperform Tesseract significantly on this dataset.
